page.overview:
Who is Hiroshi?

Hiroshi was one of the four unique benders that Yahshi scouted for Team Avatar. After Hiroshi displayed his unusual bending abilities, the gang began to discuss whether or not to recruit him. However, just as they were about to announce their decision, Hiroshi and the three other benders left to start their own group, deciding that they did not like being judged.
